groups.operation: Report an allocation failure during xmlXIncludeProcessNode through xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc).
groups.condition: The document-URL copy in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot fails after XInclude-context creation.
groups.capability: The existing check can observe XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through xinc->errNo or another valid existing failure indication.
groups.consequence: If the failure is unreported to the check, xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns allocation-failure reporting, not structured-callback configuration.

groups.operation: Configure an xmlXIncludeCtxt with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler before xmlXIncludeProcessNode.
groups.condition: Input exercises XInclude, included-document parsing, or XPointer errors.
groups.capability: Deliver errors to the context-local structured callback with its supplied data.
groups.consequence: If the handler is unset, the context-local structured error route cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns callback configuration, not allocation-failure reporting.
